response.sql: SELECT player_id, SUM(triple) as total_triples FROM batting_postseason WHERE league_id = 'NL' AND round = 'World Series' GROUP BY player_id ORDER BY total_triples IS NULL, total_triples DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: "NL and World Series postseason batting records" refers to records matching both conditions simultaneously (league_id = 'NL' AND round = 'World Series'), i.e., NL teams playing in the World Series, rather than players who appeared in both NL postseason records and World Series records across any combination of their records.

alternatives.interpretation: "Players with NL and World Series postseason batting records" means players who have at least one record with league_id = 'NL' AND separately at least one record with round = 'World Series' (possibly in different games), and we sum all their postseason triples.
alternatives.sql: SELECT player_id, SUM(triple) as total_triples FROM batting_postseason WHERE player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM batting_postseason WHERE league_id = 'NL' INTERSECT SELECT player_id FROM batting_postseason WHERE round = 'World Series') GROUP BY player_id ORDER BY total_triples IS NULL, total_triples DESC LIMIT 10;
